The direction of the line depends on which coordinate, row or column, the points share.

**Constructing Grid and Crossings**

I've noted that the vertical color 3 line at column 3, and the vertical color 5 line at column 9, each have different row spans. I'm now considering how colors will overlap at intersections. Notably, the vertical color 3 overwrites the horizontal color 2 at position (3,3), and color 5 overwrites color 7 at (7,9).
